title: Northbeam TechWorks Included Visits, Terms and Annual Care Fee
content:
What a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair service includes, and for how long, is fixed by the service the work is handled under. These are the entitlement figures of the six TechWorks services: the visits included in the agreement term at no charge, the months those included visits belong to, the fee for an annual care agreement and the months such an agreement runs, the planned maintenance visits carried out each year without a fault being reported, and the calibration passes included in one visit.

| TechWorks service | Included visits per term | Months the visits belong to | Annual care agreement fee, USD | Months an annual agreement runs | Planned maintenance visits each year | Calibration passes in one visit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 1 | 12 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 2 | 12 | 0.00 | 0 | 1 | 2 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 1 | 12 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 4 | 12 | 0.00 | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 12 | 12 | 1450.00 | 12 | 4 | 1 |

### Points of judgement on these figures

**Only one TechWorks service carries an annual fee.** TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual is payable at 1450.00 USD for an agreement running 12 months. The other five services carry an annual agreement fee of 0.00 and an agreement term of 0 months, because no annual care agreement is written under them.

**A bench job includes no visits.** Its included visits stand at 0 and the months they belong to at 0. Every other TechWorks service carries a visit term of 12 months, holding from one included visit on a standard home installation or an appliance installation up to 12 on the annual care service.

**Planned maintenance is narrower than the included visits.** Planned maintenance visits are carried out each year without a fault being reported, and only three services carry any: one on a calibration, two on a business deployment and four on the annual care service.

**Calibration passes belong to the visit, not to the term.** The calibration service includes 2 passes in one visit and the annual care service includes 1; the remaining four services include none.
